==Notes==
*Its spawn location is shared with [[Abijah the Decayed]], [[Bane Darkfist]], [[Gezna Shadowstalker]], [[Nizza the Sickle]] and [[Ziyad Soulreaper]].
*Consider [[Signet of Capture|capturing]] the skill [[Vengeance]] from this boss (if you have use for it), since it does not become available until [[Destiny's Gorge]] in the [[Crystal Desert]].
